invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new instance, never null, based on its implementation.
The returned object is always a JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter, constructed with the given parameters.
conf is passed directly to the constructor and is required to successfully create the writer, so it cannot be null upon method exit.
writeConfig is passed directly to the constructor and required for writer creation, implying it cannot be null here.
context is passed directly to the constructor and is required to create the writer instance, implying it cannot be null.
